# GTA Hub

> A machine-first encyclopedia of the Grand Theft Auto series: characters, missions, vehicles, weapons, cheats, locations and collectibles for all 17 games, published as static HTML and portable JSON.

Static site, no external services. Regenerated 2026-11-19.

## Machine entry points

- https://abinashspace.github.io/gta-hub/data/index.json — site index, all games, counts, links
- https://abinashspace.github.io/gta-hub/data/search-index.json — one object per record
- https://abinashspace.github.io/gta-hub/data/images.json — image manifest with status
- https://abinashspace.github.io/gta-hub/data/status.json — per-game coverage
- https://abinashspace.github.io/gta-hub/data/cheats.json — every cheat code, flattened across games
- https://abinashspace.github.io/gta-hub/data/locations.json — every location, flattened across games
- https://abinashspace.github.io/gta-hub/data/cross/timeline.json — releases by universe
- https://abinashspace.github.io/gta-hub/data/cross/compare.json — record counts per game and section
- https://abinashspace.github.io/gta-hub/data/schema/<section>.json — JSON Schema per record type

## Cross-game pages

- https://abinashspace.github.io/gta-hub/timeline/ — releases in order, grouped by universe
- https://abinashspace.github.io/gta-hub/compare/ — record matrix, section leaders, shared cities
- https://abinashspace.github.io/gta-hub/cheats/ — all cheat codes on one page
- https://abinashspace.github.io/gta-hub/locations/ — all locations on one page

## Record contract

Every record: id (permanent kebab slug), verified (boolean), optional source (URL).
Sections: characters, missions, vehicles, weapons, cheats, locations, collectibles.
Coverage values: complete, partial, limited, official-only, empty.
Unknown numbers are null, never 0.

## Notes

- Unofficial fan data. Trademarks belong to Rockstar Games / Take-Two Interactive.
- Artwork mostly sourced from GTA Wiki (2794/3751 slots); the rest resolve to generated placeholders. See /data/images.json for per-slot status.
